title: Graded families of ideals and convex regions
summary: We study the interplay between graded families of ideals in $\mathbb{K}$-domains and their associated convex regions. These regions, called Newton-Okounkov regions, arise naturally from graded families of ideals associated to a valuation with one-dimensional leaves. Our main focus is to compute asymptotic resurgence number of a pair of graded families of ideals.
